author: Sarah Twamley
text:
July 2020 - Free dumping.
Water Fawcett. Non-potable.
About 8 barrels for garbage.
Construction on future snack bar.
Restrooms nearby in another parking lot.
Boat launch next door.
Basketball court in this parking lot area.
Boardwalk along Mission Bay!

author: E Bri
text:
Free service!!

We have been using this service going on about 4 months now. Nice and clean most of the time with no issues.

The people that maintain the area told us that plumbers come out at least once a week cuz ppl dump paper towels, diapers, feminine hygiene, etc and drain gets clogged up. That was on a day the dump site was closed down.

Users, please clean up after yourselves and use the facilities for what it's meant to be, so that we all can continue to use this site free of charge!!

author: Joshua Lariscy
text: Great place to dump RV tanks and fill water tank. Open 24hrs. Free and easy. Only wish the water was potable. Just bring a filter and it's all good!!

author: Howard Powell
text: This is a really helpful site to dump your stuff before you travel home

author: Richard Black
text: What a great find. We stopped by after 9:00 p.m. and still found the place reasonably clean and were able to dump our black and gray water tanks and continue on our way in just 10 to 15 minutes. And it's free! Every city needs one of these.
